■ Stage Direction
Age: High school 2nd year
Personality: Frank / Refreshingly direct

To tell the truth, I've always looked up to her.
Ever since Oguri-san transferred here.
Who will take the victory—which one will it be—?!

Usually I'd take her on head-to-head, but...
Right now, I want to broaden my horizons!

A slump...
If that's the case, running as a front-runner might be effective.
So that's why she's pushing so hard.
...I want to try running as a front-runner!

I've been in peak condition lately! Must be thanks to you, Trainer!
—Whoops, almost time for morning assembly!
A chance to run a mock race with Oguri-san...?!

Oguri-senpai's in a great position! And Ryan is right on her heels!
This final stretch battle is gonna be amazing...!

When I told her to make the choice, Mejiro Ryan
thought it over carefully before looking up.

It was only for a moment... but Oguri-san looked dead serious.
She didn't look like someone in a slump at all.

Should she hone her late-stage kick for a head-on clash,
or shake things up by surprisingly running as a front-runner?
This is my... Mejiro Ryan's running!

Hey, was that Oguri-senpai just now?
Isn't she in kind of a slump?

I can't let something like this bring me down!
Roar, my major muscle groups!!

Yeah, that gleaming gray coat, no mistake about it!
Running like that... was she going all out in training...?

Yes! It was such a fiery duel...
I was just a neck away from reaching her...

Ngh...! Yes, sir!
Thank you for the guidance!
What kind of strategy should we go with in this case?
! I'll give it everything I've got!

So, right to business...
Please train me so I can beat Oguri-san!
I'm counting on you!

The Umamusume gathered one after another in the training camp lobby.
A representative trainer stepped forward.

She doesn't come from a prestigious pedigree; she's drawing attention through sheer skill alone.
In other words... she's the "real deal," isn't she?

Now that we're midway through summer camp, everyone is starting to feel the results of their training.
I'm sure many of you want to test your skills. Therefore—
There are two possible strategies.

All runners, into your designated gates!
...Start!

I'm sorry for suddenly asking to change our strategy...
I just really, really wanted to face Oguri-san at her absolute best head-on.

It's frustrating, but I'm not feeling down.
Because I didn't run away from myself, I gained real confidence!!

...I'm so glad.
That means I'll get to race against Oguri-san when she's completely serious.

On the final day of summer camp, we will be holding a mock race!
If you wish to participate, please declare your entry through your Trainer!

...Trainer.
I want to run against Oguri-san in the mock race.
The first Umamusume who has declared her entry is—Oguri Cap!

Mejiro Ryan flashed her best, brightest smile.
Looking at her, I reaffirmed my resolve once more to run alongside this girl.

One morning during summer camp.
I spotted Mejiro Ryan walking toward me while stretching.

Mejiro Ryan's answer was more serious than ever.
The fiery passion she had for this showdown reached straight to my core.

Oguri-senpai broke away! Ryan's right there too!
They're really stretching out~! It's a head-to-head showdown!!

Believing in myself...
If that's the case, then I...

...I'm going to get stronger.
Strong enough to never lose to Oguri Cap or Mejiro McQueen.

Making sure her conditioning was ready in time for the race...
You couldn't run like that unless you completely believed in yourself.
Haa... hah... phew...!

Beside Mejiro Ryan, who was smiling deeply with emotion,
the chatter of other Umamusume drifted over.

Trainer...
Will you keep supporting someone like me?

Oguri-san...!
I want to... surpass the one I've always looked up to!

Good morning, Trainer!
I'll be counting on you today as well!

With the pace-pushing strategy, we have to make sure
I don't run out of stamina keeping up that smooth, unyielding pace.
Hehe... I lost.

Right then, a gust of wind blew past right beside me.
For a split second, I thought I caught a glimpse of a white shadow...

The day of the mock race.
Just as expected, Oguri Cap had honed herself into peak condition.

Oguri-san's greatest weapon is her razor-sharp late surge...
If anything, I'm pretty much the same type.
Was that just now...?! Was that Oguri-san?!

There's no time right now, but... still...
............Huh?
